name: 任务中心
description: 给 Agent 用的结构化任务清单：注册 todo_write / todo_read 两个工具，让模型在多步任务里显式维护 pending / in_progress / completed / cancelled 状态与优先级；右侧工作面板提供任务中心视图，实时显示进度、当前进行项与剩余步骤。数据只存在插件自己的设置里，不联网、不写工作区。

en.name: Task Center
en.description: A structured task list for the agent: registers the todo_write / todo_read tools so the model keeps pending / in_progress / completed / cancelled status and priority for multi-step work, plus a Task Center view in the right work panel showing progress, the active item and the remaining steps. Data stays in the plugin's own settings; no network, nothing written into the workspace.
en.safetyNotes: The plugin stores the task list in its own plugin settings and never touches project files, the network, the clipboard or credentials. It declares only agent.tool.register, agent.prompt.inject and ui.view. The registered tools accept plain text task descriptions and write them back into plugin settings; they do not execute commands, read files or call any model.

author: local

commands.title: 任务中心：查看任务进度

agentTools.name: todo_write
agentTools.description: Create or update the structured task list for a complex coding session. Use it for multi-step work or an explicit user task list; skip it for single, trivial or purely conversational requests. Send the complete list every time: it replaces the previous one. Keep exactly one task in_progress, mark a task completed the moment it is done, and never mark work completed that you did not verify.

todos.description: The updated todo list, in execution order.

content.description: Brief description of the task, imperative mood.

agentTools.name: todo_read
agentTools.description: Read the current task list snapshot: every task with its status, priority and position, plus counts and the active task. Call it before reporting a long task as finished to confirm nothing is still pending.
